system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

- SPA-N-001 | General liability cap | seller's draft: 20% / AUD 4,800,000 general cap
- SPA-N-002 | De minimis & basket | seller's draft: Raised de minimis / aggregate basket
- SPA-N-003 | General claims time limit | seller's draft: 18-month general notice period
- SPA-N-004 | Fundamental/Title regime | seller's draft: Blur fundamental into general regime
- SPA-N-005 | Fraud carve-out | seller's draft: Subject fraud to contractual limits
- SPA-N-006 | Disclosure scope | seller's draft: Whole-data-room / public-register deemed disclosure (disclosure letter §1.1-1.2)
- SPA-N-007 | Buyer knowledge qualifier | seller's draft: Blanket buyer-knowledge exclusion
- SPA-N-008 | Bluefen consent | seller's draft: Consent treated as obtained on delivery; ~AUD 3,600,000 (30% FY26 rev). AUD 75k payment unverified.
- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding
- SPA-N-010 | Employee bonuses | seller's draft: AUD 420,000 closing bonuses excluded from funds flow (DD-005)
- SPA-N-011 | Ironquay IP indemnity | seller's draft: Narrow indemnity; DD-004/DD-010 AUD 180,000 open, SOW3 transfer conditioned on payment
- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary
- SPA-N-013 | Sandbar renewals | seller's draft: Three renewals AUD 110,000 each = AUD 330,000 aggregate
- SPA-N-014 | Category separation | seller's draft: General regime overriding specific categories
- SPA-N-015 | Title verification | seller's draft: DD-012 share register offered as proof of title
- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
# REVIEW OF SELLER’S UPDATED SPA & DISCLOSURE LETTER  
**Project Kestrel – Wattlebridge Holdings (Buyer) / Harbourglass Ventures (Seller)**  

---

## 1.  EXECUTIVE SUMMARY  

The Seller’s “fair and balanced” package **systematically under-delivers against every core protection in our playbook**.  The draft collapses fundamental/title warranties into the general regime, imposes a 20 % cap without authority, widens thresholds 5-fold, shortens the claim period to 18 months without approval, applies limitations to fraud/wilful misconduct, relies on whole-data-room disclosure, imposes a blanket constructive-knowledge bar, treats Bluefen consent as “reasonable endeavours + delivery”, pushes Riverlark discharge post-completion without an irrevocable undertaking, silently omits the AUD 420 k bonuses (plus on-costs) from the funds flow, keeps the Ironquay indemnity narrow, pre-classifies Sandbar renewals as ordinary course, folds Tax/IP into the weakened general regime, and offers only the internal share register for title.  

**Bottom line:**  This draft is not a negotiating position—it is a roll-up of Seller-favourable defaults.  Every item below requires a hard mark-up; none can be accepted as-is.

---

## 2.  CLAUSE-BY-CLAUSE DEPARTURES & REASONING  

| # | Playbook Requirement | Seller Draft | Departure & Risk |
|---|----------------------|--------------|------------------|
| **1** | **General cap: 25 % / AUD 6 M** (20 % / AUD 4.8 M only with Amelia Frost written authority – **none given**) | 20 % / AUD 4.8 M (Cl. 12.1) | **Uses fallback without authority.**  AUD 1.2 M less protection.  Must hold at 25 % unless principal approves otherwise. |
| **2** | **De minimis AUD 5 k; basket AUD 50 k (first-dollar once exceeded)** | De minimis AUD 25 k; basket AUD 250 k (excess-only) (Cl. 12.2) | **5× wider thresholds.**  Seller’s “excess-only” basket means first AUD 250 k of aggregate claims is irrecoverable; playbook requires seller to pay from dollar one once AUD 50 k is crossed. |
| **3** | **General claim period: 24 months** (18 months only with Amelia Frost approval – **none given**) | 18 months notification (Cl. 12.3/13) | **Shortens by 6 months without approval.**  Also, Seller proposes “limitations apply to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise” – a trojan horse to swallow fundamental/title claims. |
| **4** | **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, 100 % cap, ≥ 6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | Capacity & title “subject to same caps and time limits as general warranties for administrative simplicity” | **Total collapse of fundamental protections.**  Title/capacity claims would be capped at AUD 4.8 M, barred after 18 months, subject to AUD 250 k basket and buyer-knowledge exclusion.  Unacceptable. |
| **5** | **Fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct: carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance. Non-waivable.** | Limitations, exclusive remedy, non-reliance apply to “all Claims of any nature” (Cl. 9.3/12.8/20.5) | **Expressly includes fraud/wilful misconduct in limitations.**  Directly contradicts playbook; would be unenforceable in any event but must be excised. |
| **6** | **Specific fair disclosure only; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure** | General disclosure of entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers (Disclosure Letter §§1.1–1.2) | **Whole-data-room disclosure shifts diligence risk to Buyer.**  Schedule 7 must be limited to specific, page-referenced disclosures that fairly reveal the matter. |
| **7** | **Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions; any qualifier = named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; never excuse title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity** | “Buyer shall have no claim in respect of any matter of which the Buyer or its advisers had knowledge, including any matter discoverable from the data room or public records” (Cl. 8.3) | **Constructive knowledge (“discoverable”) + adviser knowledge + no carve-outs for title/capacity/fraud/indemnities.**  Must be redlined to actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals only, with fundamental/title/fraud/indemnity carve-outs. |
| **8** | **Bluefen: effective consent + evidence conditions satisfied pre-Completion; reasonable endeavours insufficient** | “Reasonable endeavours; consent satisfied on delivery of counterparty’s written consent” (Cl. 3/6.3) | **No condition-satisfaction evidence; delivery ≠ effectiveness.**  Disclosure Letter confirms no final consent or condition sign-off as at 22 Sep 2026.  Must be a condition precedent with documented satisfaction. |
| **9** | **Riverlark: current payout from Completion funds + effective security releases; post-completion release only with irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval** | “Release to be provided following Completion” (Cl. 2/7) | **No repayment from Completion funds, no security discharge at Completion, no irrevocable undertaking, no principal approval.**  Disclosure confirms ~AUD 3.2 M outstanding, no discharge.  Funds flow must show direct payoff + releases at Completion. |
| **10** | **DD-005 bonuses AUD 420 k + on-costs = specific line item or Seller-funded; not silently excluded** | “Bonuses are a matter for the Seller and are not separately itemised in the funds flow” | **Silent exclusion creates post-completion liability risk (payroll tax, super, workers comp).**  Must appear as a distinct Completion adjustment or Seller undertaking to pay. |
| **11** | **Ironquay: broaden indemnity, preserve SOW3 cure; AUD 180 k not independently verified** | “Existing indemnity limited to SOW3 payment considered adequate” (Cl. 11.1) | **Narrow indemnity remains; no independent verification of AUD 180 k payment or assignment.**  Disclosure confirms no bank receipt, no confirmatory assignment.  Indemnity must cover all IP transfer defects, not just SOW3 fee. |
| **12** | **Export/privacy (DD-006): preserve logs, investigate, require updates; assume NO confirmed breach/harm/notification duty
=== END ADVICE ===
